projects.title: SQL Data Warehouse
projects.subtitle: Layered Medallion Architecture with Star Schema Modeling
projects.architecture: Bronze (Raw Ingestion) ➔ Silver (Cleansed/Normalized) ➔ Gold (Business Dimensions & Facts)
projects.summary: Engineered an enterprise-grade analytical data warehouse showcasing end-to-end data warehousing best practices. Implemented layered bronze/silver/gold data structures, star-schema modeling, and historical change tracking.
deliverables: Designed star schema dimensional model with partitioned Fact and Dimension tables
Authored optimized T-SQL ETL workflows for extraction, cleansing, validation, and staging
Implemented Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1 & Type 2) for historical auditing
Applied advanced query optimization, indexing strategies, and automated data reconciliation routines

projects.title: Walmart Sales Analytics
projects.subtitle: Databricks PySpark Lakehouse with Incremental Delta Lake Upserts
projects.architecture: Databricks PySpark Lakehouse ➔ Delta Lake ACID Storage ➔ Analytical Aggregations
projects.summary: Built a distributed retail analytics data pipeline processing high-volume transaction feeds with strict schema validation, business-rule transformations, and incremental upserts.
deliverables: Enforced schema validation and bad-record quarantine logic to eliminate corrupt ingestions
Developed business-rule transformations, time-series aggregations, and metric calculations
Implemented incremental processing using Delta Lake MERGE INTO syntax for fast deduplication
Configured partition pruning, Z-ordering, and in-memory caching for low-latency queries

projects.title: AWS CDC Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Event-Driven Change Data Capture with DMS, Lambda, Glue & S3
projects.architecture: RDS MySQL ➔ AWS DMS ➔ S3 Bronze ➔ Lambda Event ➔ Glue ETL ➔ Redshift / S3 Gold
projects.summary: Architected a serverless event-driven Change Data Capture pipeline streaming real-time transactional modifications into a curated cloud lakehouse and Redshift warehouse.
deliverables: Configured continuous binlog Change Data Capture replication via AWS Database Migration Service (DMS)
Engineered event-driven orchestration triggering AWS Lambda on S3 raw landing events
Developed PySpark AWS Glue ETL jobs executing deduplication, schema normalization, and SCD tracking
Established comprehensive observability, CloudWatch alarms, and metric dashboards for SLA compliance
